b_1.speaker: Narration
b_1.text: A red-stamped envelope waits on the table. The bills are past due, and the bank closes at five.

b_2.speaker: Narration
b_2.text: It needs a clear head and a steady hand — but the ticking clock is its own kind of pressure. Who takes it on?

b_strong.speaker: Narration
b_strong.text: The numbers line up, the calls get made, the page gets signed. Handled, cleanly, with time to spare.

b_ok.speaker: Narration
b_ok.text: It mostly gets done — a couple of lines left for tomorrow, but the worst of it is paid.

b_strain.speaker: Narration
b_strain.text: The figures blur and the dread rises. The envelope goes back in the drawer, only half-dealt-with.

b_done.speaker: Narration
b_done.text: Whatever got done, the day moves on.
